summary: A group marked «related» holds other records rather than fields. The component composes a data view in it, and that view asks the host for its own port.

then.note: The records themselves never travel through this port. A related list asks for a data-view port by raising sf-host-port-request with the owner, the record and the group, and the host answers with the port it already implements for collections. Routing rows, columns, sorting and paging through the property-view seam instead would duplicate a whole vocabulary and make the property view a relay for one it does not speak.
